title: The pack can lead with a fact held only in a data table, so a question answered by claude/models.csv packs it first
goal: Found in SP-vayhvwfy (ST-hcc7a3fd, gate g1): the false-good question 'Claude Sonnet 5.5 model release capabilities pricing context window' is answered by claude/models.csv, but rag.py pack leads with agents/agent-caching.md; an eval row expecting the csv fails on its path and doc2query expands only .md facts, so no eval row or expansion could fix it. The pack ranks a data table's rows as it ranks article facts (or an expansion route exists for them), and that question packs with models.csv in the lead.

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Claude Sonnet 5.5 model release capabilities pricing context window','--budget','300'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;lead=o.split('## ',1)[-1].split(chr(10),1)[0];print('lead:',lead[:80]);sys.exit(0 if 'models.csv' in lead else 1)
